title: A Google Director Open-Sourced His Claude Skills
description:
A Google director open-sourced his entire AI agent workflow — 23 markdown files, 51K GitHub stars, free to clone today: github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills. The standout file makes your agent doubt and re-check its own work before it ships, and the whole skill set runs across three different agents — the opencode port is a single 10-byte symlink.

Full video covers the file-by-file teardown — every skill walked through on camera and how to wire them into your own agent: https://youtube.com/watch?v=QNP7Pn7nf2g

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #AgentSkills #AddyOsmani #AICoding #AIagents #SKILLmd #OpenSource
